about: Venues whose own websites Soundcheck may read. An entry is added only after the venue passed the compliance gate (own data, robots.txt allows, terms do not forbid); reading it also needs its key in soundcheck.ingestion.venues.sites. Coordinates: postcodes.io for the postcode (2025-06-05). ticketmasterVenueId pins the venue to the one Ticketmaster created. notRead: venues whose own listings are deliberately not read: the six held back (The Water Rats, the Music Glue sites, Signature Brew) and every venue the London venue research marked 'ask'; the app shows the reason wherever such a venue appears. postcodePrefix pins a common name to one place; without it a name matches only within 25 km of central London.

venues.notes: Public keyless JSON API documented at /developers/; robots.txt invites API use.
The Events Calendar REST API; times labelled UTC+0 are London wall-clock times; titles are sentences.
The Events Calendar REST API; same timezone label quirk as Amersham Arms.

The All Events page's own show pages, embedded as JSON (the first 50; Cargo loads the rest by script, not read). Switched from the RSS (about 10 most recently added) on 2025-07-04; moth-rss still reads the feed. robots.txt Crawl-delay 2.
Squarespace events page (server HTML); robots.txt disallows ?format=json/ical, so only the page is read. Times are doors.

Squarespace events page (server HTML); robots.txt disallows ?format=json/ical, so only the page is read. Lists both rooms; Ticketmaster has three rows for the building (The Dome, Downstairs at The Dome, The Dome London), linked as siblings.
Squarespace events page (server HTML); robots.txt disallows ?format=json/ical, so only the page is read. Terms checked: no automated-access clause.
Squarespace summary blocks: a day and month, no time (date-only).
Squarespace summary blocks on the home page: full dates, no time (date-only).
A community pub: Squarespace list sections, 'Fri 2 Oct / 19:00 / £12' lines; regulars and non-music nights are skipped.
schema.org Event JSON-LD on the events page; start times without an offset are London time.
Own PHP listing; no robots.txt (the path returns a page), no terms found. Club nights (.grid-item-club) are not read. Times are doors.
Home page listing (bookings by Bugbear); one act per line; 'Doors 7.15' read as 19:15.
WordPress list with schema.org microdata; the start date is a date (00:00), the time element gives doors and curfew.
Same site build as EartH. Well covered by Ticketmaster: keep only if make venue-coverage says so.
WordPress gigs page; '7PM' times.
robots.txt Crawl-delay 10 (honoured by PoliteFetcher). The list gives no time (date-only); many nights are club nights, skipped.
WordPress panels; regulars ('Every Tuesday …') have no date and are reported as NO_DATE; comedy and quizzes skipped.
Own site and ticketing; robots.txt Crawl-delay 10; pages followed ("?page=2"), up to the source's 10-page limit. Times are start times. Address not on the listings page (well-known; check).
WordPress/Elementor loop of 'gig' posts; dates only on the list. Thin Ticketmaster coverage (7). Address not on the listings page (well-known; check).
Star Pubs site (terms checked: no automated-access clause); free entry, RSVP via DICE. Club nights skipped.
